Questions.content: What is the rationale behind checking for single-element lists separately instead of incorporating this logic into the adjacent element comparison? This seems redundant since a single-element list trivially satisfies the condition of being sorted.
What is the rationale behind including a separate task for detecting duplicates if the adjacent element comparison can inherently check for duplicates as well? This seems to introduce redundancy.
